subject: Second scanned form - handwriting quality poor, please advise
bodyText:
To Whom It May Concern,

Attaching a second scanned adverse event form, also related to Drug "Verolan." This one
was completed quickly during a busy clinic day and the handwriting is harder to read in
places - in particular the dose field looks smudged and the reporter's role is
abbreviated in a way that isn't entirely clear to us either.

We wanted to send it as-is rather than delay reporting while we tracked down the
original nurse for clarification. Please flag any fields that need confirmation and we
will follow up with the clinic.

Records Office
Rural Health Post
